about.title: About Rosewood Insurance Group
text: Rosewood Insurance Group is your independent licensed insurance agency serving clients throughout the entire Lone Star State of Texas! We are committed to being the most knowledgeable, trustworthy, and professional provider of insurance risk management services. We specialize in legal professional insurance, flood insurance, and real estate investor insurance—but are capable of serving whatever your business and personal insurance needs are through our partnerships with top-rated carriers.

Our goal is to achieve long-term relationships and dedicated customer service focused on bringing value, sound advice, and personal attention to your risk management solutions. Protecting yourself financially will always be in your best interest to prepare you for the unexpected. Contact us today to learn more about how we can help.
Contact or stop by our local office in Friendswood, TX. Our community members and clients alike have our full attention, regardless of where they are in the insurance process.
